## Per-app access control
Use this sub-workflow at the start of **every webhook in your apps** (right after the Webhook with JWT Auth): inputs `app_id` and `email` (= `$json.jwtPayload.email`).

Returns `{allowed: true}` or `{allowed: false, error: {code: "app_forbidden", message}}`. If access is not allowed, respond with **403 and that JSON** (the app shows the message).
